correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the six linear scalar equations for AB=ωBA in T_3(F_q), including the diagonal equations (1-ω)au=(1-ω)bv=(1-ω)cw=0, two adjacent-entry equations and one (1,3)-entry equation. Splitting by zero, one, two, or three nonzero diagonal entries and checking the resonances a=ωb, b=ωc, a=ωc yields the seven N_d polynomials. The three resonance equalities cannot hold simultaneously for ω≠1, and a two-resonance stratum requires the extra x=0 or y=0 condition precisely where specified. The symbolic totals sum to q^6; weighted by q^d, they give q^3(2q-1)(11q²-15q+5) ordered pairs. Subtract 2q^6-1 zero-factor pairs for the directed nonzero graph. Independently recomputed all 4^6=4096 A over F4 with ω of order three by row reduction of the six-by-six system: nullity counts [576,2016,1296,180,24,3,1], 54208 pairs, matching formulas. Finite verification cannot establish arbitrary finite fields; the complete stratum proof supplies that extension.
